decisions.nm: Samuel Mukira Mohochi v. The Attorney General of the Republic of Uganda
decisions.ct: East African Court of Justice (First Instance Division)
decisions.pe: Kenyan advocate denied entry to Uganda, detained and sent back; denial of entry to a citizen of a Partner State without due process breached the EAC Treaty (Arts 6(d), 7(2), 104) and Art. 7 of the Common Market Protocol; s.52 of the Citizenship and Immigration Control Act inoperative for EAC citizens.
decisions.pi: Advokat Kenya ditolak masuk ke Uganda, ditahan, lalu dipulangkan; penolakan masuk terhadap warga negara anggota Komunitas Afrika Timur tanpa proses yang layak melanggar Traktat EAC dan Protokol Pasar Bersama; Pasal 52 Undang-Undang Kewarganegaraan dan Pengawasan Imigrasi Uganda tidak berlaku bagi warga EAC.
